d:
Every love story begins with a moment… and Maruva Tarama celebrates the beauty of that moment.”
A romantic musical love drama that blends emotion, melody, and the magic of unexpected connections.
In theatres from November 28.
Starring: Hariish Dhanunjaya, Athulya Chandra, Avantika Hari Nalwa
Music: Vijai Bulganin & Arish
DOP: Rudra Sai
Editor: K.S.R
Choreography: Ajay Shivashankar
